covers: The data and control ports of the two channels as the combined handlers decode them: keys 0x100 to 0x103 are the offsets of cd_ba_r and cd_ba_w and keys 0x110 to 0x113 those of ba_cd_r and ba_cd_w, kept above the register numbers of the z80sio dictionary; the direct handlers (da, db, ca, cb) are one port each and are named in the device entry

entries.name: cd_ba port read
entries.description: Combined read: offset bit 1 picks control or data, bit 0 picks channel B or A.
entries.behaviour: Offset 0 reads data A, 1 data B, 2 control A, 3 control B. A data read returns the oldest received character and advances the FIFO, unless first-character mode holds a framing or overrun error; an empty FIFO repeats the last one. A control read returns RR0 to RR2 as the pointer says.

entries.name: cd_ba port write
entries.description: Combined write: offset bit 1 picks control or data, bit 0 picks channel B or A.
entries.behaviour: Offset 0 writes data A, 1 data B, 2 control A, 3 control B. A data write loads the transmit buffer (an unsent byte is lost), clears the transmit interrupt and, in async mode with the transmitter enabled and idle, starts sending. A control write goes to the register the pointer names, then clears it.

entries.name: ba_cd port read
entries.description: Combined read: offset bit 0 picks control or data, bit 1 picks channel B or A.

A control read returns RR0 to RR2 as the pointer says.
